# Serper

Serper provides real-time Google search results, place data, autocomplete suggestions, and webpage extraction through a structured API.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/serper/.

## Actions

- **Batch Search the Web** (read-only): Run 1-10 independent first-page Google web searches in one native Serper request.
- **Get Search Suggestions** (read-only): Return Google autocomplete suggestions for a partial search query without running a full search.
- **List Locations** (read-only): Find canonical Serper location names and country codes for localizing search requests.
- **List Place Reviews** (read-only): Return paginated Google reviews for one place identified by Place ID, feature ID, or CID, with optional sorting and topic filtering.
- **Scrape Webpage** (read-only): Ask Serper to fetch one webpage and return extracted text, metadata, and optionally markdown, links, images, and videos.
- **Search Images** (read-only): Search Google Images and return one page of source pages, full image URLs, thumbnails, dimensions, and positions.
- **Search Maps** (read-only): Search Google Maps by text, Place ID, or CID, optionally constrained to a viewport, and return one page of rich place identifiers and…
- **Search News** (read-only): Search recent Google News coverage and return one page of article titles, links, sources, publication times, snippets, and images when…
- **Search Scholar** (read-only): Search Google Scholar and return one page of academic publications with citation counts, publication metadata, snippets, and PDF links…
- **Search Shopping** (read-only): Search Google Shopping and return one page of products, prices, merchants, offers, ratings, images, and product IDs.
- **Search the Web** (read-only): Search Google web results and return one page of organic links plus available answer, knowledge, question, related-search, and top-story…
